 Follow Who Is Manni L. Perez? All About the ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ Actress
 Bethany Gemmell Tue, November 17, 2026 at 8:15 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Who Is Manni L. Perez? All About the ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ Actress Grand Theft Auto VI's early success at The Game Awards has finally confirmed the identity of the actress behind Lucia Caminos, one of two protagonists in the industry-changing game, set for release on November 19.
 Manni L. Perez was nominated for Best Performance for her role in the upcoming sixth instalment of the crime-action franchise, and although Rockstar Games is yet to confirm its voice cast, all signs point towards Perez, who bears a strong physical resemblance to the character, playing Lucia.
 Here's everything we know about the rising star ahead of the game's official launch, including her previous roles, fighting skills, and unusual career trajectory.
 Manni L. Perez Is an Actress With Over a Decade of Experience — Including Previous GTA Games
 Manni L. Perez, born in New York City on September 8, 1992, is an American actress and weightlifter, as stated on Perez's Instagram account .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement According to Perez's IMDb page , her earliest on-screen acting credit dates back to 2013, which was, funnily enough, two Grand Theft Auto games. The actress provided the voice of "Clubber 2" in the last instalment of the juggernaut franchise, Grand Theft Auto V . That same year, Perez reprised the character for Grand Theft Auto Online , along with an additional voice role as "Blackjack Dealer" in the "Diamond Casino & Resort" update.
 Outside of Grand Theft Auto , the actress, who is of Puerto Rican and Dominican heritage, starred in Spike Lee's TV reboot of his 1986 classic She's Gotta Have It , along with guest appearances in high-profile shows such as Marvel's Jessica Jones , Chicago P.D. , The Outlier , Law & Order: Special Victims Unit , and a voice role in an episode of Dora , the reboot of the long-running children's series Dora the Explorer. 
 A graduate of New York's prestigious Tisch School of the Arts, Perez also has acting credits in the indie films Fire Island (2023), The Unborn (2020), and Armageddon Tales (2021). According to an interview with PAZ Magazine from 2018, Perez started her career as a professional belly dancer until she was encouraged by a professor at SUNY Orange to try acting.
 As she went on to state in the interview, and as shown further on her social media, Perez is trained in Muay Thai, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, and Mixed Martial Arts (MMA), stating that her "ability to fight, handle guns, do stunts, while also making sure I keep up on my talent, gives me the upper hand in the audition room and the industry" — something that likely helped the actress land the leading role in GTA VI.
